overview: A full-stack Test Practice Platform built on the Internet Computer. Admins create and manage tests with rich text questions, math formulas, answer explanations, sections, timers, and images. Users practice questions, track mastery, review answers, and see detailed results. Features include admin dashboard with key stats, offline-first caching, 2FA security, and multi-test support.
features: HTML rendering fix — rich text and math formulas display correctly everywhere
Admin dashboard with stats (users, tests, questions, mastery rates)
Professional math editor with symbol palette and live preview
Answer explanations per question (shows after answering and in review)
Review mode — navigate all questions with correct answers and explanations after test
User management — admin can activate/deactivate accounts
Mastery tracking — answer correctly 5 times to master a question
Offline-first — questions cached locally for fast load times
Sections — organize questions and practice specific sections
Multi-test support — up to 5 tests in progress simultaneously
